## Task packet

Link: `development/docs/task-packets/TASK-XXX.md`

## Entry gate (all YES before coding)

- [ ] Release/roadmap identifier named
- [ ] Role journey + action references linked
- [ ] Permission/visibility + denial test named
- [ ] State ownership + module named
- [ ] UI behaviour + failure/recovery references linked
- [ ] Policy values approved or explicitly demo-only
- [ ] Tests named (unit/API/E2E/security/accessibility/recovery as applicable)
- [ ] Out-of-scope list written
- [ ] No blocking design gap (or GAP record linked)
- [ ] Lead + reviewer assigned

## Branch

`feat|fix|docs|chore/<ID>-short-name` (one short-lived branch per issue, 19.26)
